issue_context.title: Unclear how to dispose of EffectComposer
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**

In Three.js, how do I clean-up an `EffectComposer`? It does not appear to have a "dispose" method. 

However, as far as I understand it, it uses two instances of `RenderTarget` internally, so I am assuming these need to be disposed of just like any other `RenderTarget` would?

**Expected behavior**

It seems reasonable to assume that `EffectComposer` would have a dispose method.

review_comments: When this PR is merged, I'm planning to add more `dispose()` methods to the pass classes in `jsm/postprocessing` 👍 .
